text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, no matter how cute you might be,
you're still an adult, aren't you?
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. You showed up in my dream today
as a little kid, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
They chased after me calling me "Mommy."
Haa... it was so adorable.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I got to spoil you so much,
I feel fantastic today♪"
I was left with mixed feelings... but at least she got some solid rest, which is what matters most.
